# Setup 
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

final <- fread(
  "nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv",
  select = c(
    "game_id", "team", "opp_team", "period", "interval_start",
    "player_id", "fwd_def", "is_5v5", "shift_age_mid_sec",
    "xGF_5v5", "xGA_5v5", "score_diff"
  )
)

setDT(final)

required_columns <- c(
  "game_id", "team", "opp_team", "period", "interval_start",
  "player_id", "fwd_def", "is_5v5", "shift_age_mid_sec",
  "xGF_5v5", "xGA_5v5", "score_diff"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(final))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Collapse directly to one team x 5-second interval row
team_5v5 <- final[
  is_5v5 == 1L &
    !is.na(player_id) &
    !is.na(shift_age_mid_sec),
  .(
    opp_team = first(opp_team),
    score_diff = first(score_diff),

    n_skaters = uniqueN(player_id),

    n_forwards = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Forward"]
    ),

    n_defense = uniqueN(
      player_id[fwd_def == "Defense"]
    ),

    mean_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec
    ),

    median_shift_age_sec = median(
      shift_age_mid_sec,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    max_shift_age_sec = safe_max(
      shift_age_mid_sec
    ),

    mean_forward_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec[fwd_def == "Forward"]
    ),

    mean_defense_shift_age_sec = safe_mean(
      shift_age_mid_sec[fwd_def == "Defense"]
    ),

    xGF_5v5 = first(xGF_5v5),
    xGA_5v5 = first(xGA_5v5)
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    team,
    period,
    interval_start
  )
]

# Keep only standard 5-skater units
team_5v5 <- team_5v5[
  n_skaters == 5L &
    n_forwards == 3L &
    n_defense == 2L
]

fwrite(
  team_5v5,
  "nhl_2025_26_team_interval_5v5.csv"
)

cat(
  "Valid 5v5 team intervals:",
  nrow(team_5v5),
  "\n"
)

# Free the huge player-level file from memory
rm(final)
gc()
```

Margin CI
```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)


# xG margin for each team 5-second interval
team_5v5[
  ,
  xg_margin := xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5
]

# Keep the plotted range
margin_model_data <- team_5v5[
  shift_age_bin <= 90 &
    !is.na(xg_margin) &
    !is.na(shift_age_bin)
]

# One coefficient for each shift-age bin
margin_model <- lm(
  xg_margin ~ factor(shift_age_bin) - 1,
  data = margin_model_data
)

# Standard errors clustered by game
margin_test <- coeftest(
  margin_model,
  vcov = vcovCL(
    margin_model,
    cluster = ~ game_id
  )
)

# Build plotting table
margin_by_shift_age <- data.table(
  shift_age_bin = sort(
    unique(margin_model_data$shift_age_bin)
  ),
  mean_margin = margin_test[, "Estimate"],
  se = margin_test[, "Std. Error"]
)

# 95% confidence intervals
margin_by_shift_age[
  ,
  `:=`(
    ymin = mean_margin - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = mean_margin + 1.96 * se
  )
]

# Add interval/game counts for reference
sample_sizes <- margin_model_data[
  ,
  .(
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = shift_age_bin
]

margin_by_shift_age <- merge(
  margin_by_shift_age,
  sample_sizes,
  by = "shift_age_bin",
  all.x = TRUE
)

setorder(
  margin_by_shift_age,
  shift_age_bin
)

xg_margin_5v5 <- ggplot(
  margin_by_shift_age,
  aes(
    x = shift_age_bin,
    y = mean_margin
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
    ),
    fill = "darkgreen",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    color = "darkgreen"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "5v5 xG Margin by Unit Shift Length",
    subtitle = "95% CI with standard errors clustered by game",
    x = "Average unit shift age (5-second bins)",
    y = "xG Margin"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
xg_margin_5v5

ggsave(
  "../images/xg_margin_5v5.png",
  plot = xg_margin_5v5,
  width = 7,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# linear model
#game clustered SE
```{r}
team_5v5[, xg_margin := xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5]

model_data <- team_5v5[
  unit_shift_age_sec <= 90 &
    !is.na(xg_margin) &
    !is.na(unit_shift_age_sec)
]

m1 <- lm(
  xg_margin ~ unit_shift_age_sec,
  data = model_data
)

coeftest(
  m1,
  vcov = vcovCL(
    m1,
    cluster = ~ game_id
  )
)

# Game-clustered covariance matrix
V_m1 <- vcovCL(
  m1,
  cluster = ~ game_id
)

# Regression coefficient per second
beta <- coef(m1)["unit_shift_age_sec"]

# Game-clustered standard error
se_beta <- sqrt(
  V_m1["unit_shift_age_sec", "unit_shift_age_sec"]
)

# p-value from clustered coefficient test
m1_test <- coeftest(
  m1,
  vcov = V_m1
)

p_value <- m1_test[
  "unit_shift_age_sec",
  "Pr(>|t|)"
]

# Convert to a 30-second association
regression_results <- data.table(
  effect_per_30_sec = 30 * beta,
  lower_95 = 30 * (beta - 1.96 * se_beta),
  upper_95 = 30 * (beta + 1.96 * se_beta),
  p_value = p_value
)

regression_results
```


#5 on 5 effect
```{r}
team_5v5[
  ,
  shift_length_group := cut(
    unit_shift_age_sec,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 30, 45, 60, Inf),
    labels = c(
      "0-30",
      "30-45",
      "45-60",
      "60+"
    ),
    right = FALSE
  )
]

shift_effect <- team_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    xGF = mean(xGF_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    xGA = mean(xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    xG_margin = mean(xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = shift_length_group
]

shift_effect

short_shift <- shift_effect[
  shift_length_group == "0-30"
]

long_shift <- shift_effect[
  shift_length_group == "60+"
]

xgf_drop_pct <- 100 * (
  short_shift$xGF - long_shift$xGF
) / short_shift$xGF

xga_increase_pct <- 100 * (
  long_shift$xGA - short_shift$xGA
) / short_shift$xGA

xgf_drop_pct
xga_increase_pct
```

During the first 30 seconds of a shift, teams had an average 5v5 xG differential of +0.000254 per 5-second interval. Once the average unit shift age reached 60 seconds or more, the differential fell to −0.001143. Compared with the first 30 seconds, xGF decreased by approximately 38.22% while xGA increased by approximately 25.85%.


#compared to penalty kill
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Average xGA:
# exact 5v5 vs penalty kill
# One team x 5-second interval = one observation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load only columns needed for 5v5 vs PK comparison
strength_data <- fread(
  "nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv",
  select = c(
    "game_id",
    "team",
    "period",
    "interval_start",
    "is_5v5",
    "strength",
    "xGA"
  )
)

xga_compare <- strength_data[
  is_5v5 == 1L | strength == "PK",
  .(
    state = fifelse(
      first(is_5v5) == 1L,
      "5v5",
      "Penalty Kill"
    ),
    xGA = first(xGA)
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    team,
    period,
    interval_start
  )
]


# Average xGA in each state
xga_summary <- xga_compare[
  ,
  .(
    mean_xGA = mean(xGA, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)
  ),
  by = state
]

xga_summary

xga_5v5 <- xga_summary[
  state == "5v5",
  mean_xGA
]

xga_pk <- xga_summary[
  state == "Penalty Kill",
  mean_xGA
]

pk_xga_increase_pct <-
  100 * (xga_pk - xga_5v5) / xga_5v5

pk_xga_increase_pct

relative_size <-
  xga_increase_pct / pk_xga_increase_pct

100 * relative_size

rm(strength_data, xga_compare)
gc()
```
When a team takes a penalty and goes on the penalty kill they see around a 64.7% increase in xGA compared to 5 on 5. At 5v5, average xGA was approximately 25.85% higher when average unit shift age reached 60+ seconds compared with the first 30 seconds of a shift.

The increase in xGA associated with a 60+ second 5v5 shift is about 39.96% as large as the increase in xGA associated with going on the penalty kill.


#Cutoff Determination
```{r}
library(gt)

shift_age_support <- team_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    n_intervals = .N,
    n_games = uniqueN(game_id)),
  by = shift_age_bin
]

setorder(
  shift_age_support,
  shift_age_bin
)

shift_age_support[
  ,
  pct_of_intervals :=
    100 * n_intervals / sum(n_intervals)
]

shift_age_support[
  shift_age_bin <= 120
] |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    shift_age_bin = "Shift Age (sec)",
    n_intervals = "5-Second Intervals",
    n_games = "Games",
    pct_of_intervals = "Percent of Intervals"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = pct_of_intervals,
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = pct_of_intervals
    ),
    fn = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) |>
  fmt_integer(
    columns = c(
      n_intervals,
      n_games,
    ),
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Sample Size by Average Unit Shift Age",
    subtitle = "Exact 5-on-5 team intervals"
  )
```









#all needed Confidence Intervals and bootstrapping
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CONFIDENCE INTERVALS FOR MAIN 5v5 RESULTS
# ============================================================

library(data.table)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# Make sure margin exists
team_5v5[
  ,
  xg_margin := xGF_5v5 - xGA_5v5
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 0-30 vs 60+:
#    clustered CIs for xG margin
# ------------------------------------------------------------

compare_data <- team_5v5[
  unit_shift_age_sec < 30 |
    unit_shift_age_sec >= 60
]

compare_data[
  ,
  long_shift := as.integer(
    unit_shift_age_sec >= 60
  )
]

m_margin <- lm(
  xg_margin ~ long_shift,
  data = compare_data
)

margin_vcov <- vcovCL(
  m_margin,
  cluster = ~ game_id
)

margin_test <- coeftest(
  m_margin,
  vcov = margin_vcov
)

margin_test


# Coefficients and covariance matrix
b <- coef(m_margin)
V <- margin_vcov


# 0-30 mean
margin_0_30 <- b["(Intercept)"]

se_0_30 <- sqrt(
  V[
    "(Intercept)",
    "(Intercept)"
  ]
)


# 60+ mean
margin_60_plus <-
  b["(Intercept)"] +
  b["long_shift"]

se_60_plus <- sqrt(
  V["(Intercept)", "(Intercept)"] +
    V["long_shift", "long_shift"] +
    2 * V["(Intercept)", "long_shift"]
)


# Difference:
# 60+ minus 0-30
margin_difference <-
  b["long_shift"]

se_difference <- sqrt(
  V["long_shift", "long_shift"]
)


margin_results <- data.table(
  result = c(
    "0-30 mean margin",
    "60+ mean margin",
    "60+ minus 0-30"
  ),

  estimate = c(
    margin_0_30,
    margin_60_plus,
    margin_difference
  ),

  lower = c(
    margin_0_30 - 1.96 * se_0_30,
    margin_60_plus - 1.96 * se_60_plus,
    margin_difference - 1.96 * se_difference
  ),

  upper = c(
    margin_0_30 + 1.96 * se_0_30,
    margin_60_plus + 1.96 * se_60_plus,
    margin_difference + 1.96 * se_difference
  )
)

margin_results


# ============================================================
# 2. FAST GAME-CLUSTER BOOTSTRAP
#
# Gives CIs for:
#   - xGF percentage decrease
#   - xGA percentage increase
#   - PK xGA increase
#   - relative size of long-shift effect vs PK effect
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2a. Collapse 5v5 long/short data to GAME LEVEL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

game_5v5_stats <- team_5v5[
  ,
  .(
    # 0-30 xGF
    short_xgf_sum = sum(
      xGF_5v5[
        unit_shift_age_sec < 30
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    short_xgf_n = sum(
      unit_shift_age_sec < 30 &
        !is.na(xGF_5v5)
    ),

    # 0-30 xGA
    short_xga_sum = sum(
      xGA_5v5[
        unit_shift_age_sec < 30
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    short_xga_n = sum(
      unit_shift_age_sec < 30 &
        !is.na(xGA_5v5)
    ),

    # 60+ xGF
    long_xgf_sum = sum(
      xGF_5v5[
        unit_shift_age_sec >= 60
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    long_xgf_n = sum(
      unit_shift_age_sec >= 60 &
        !is.na(xGF_5v5)
    ),

    # 60+ xGA
    long_xga_sum = sum(
      xGA_5v5[
        unit_shift_age_sec >= 60
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    long_xga_n = sum(
      unit_shift_age_sec >= 60 &
        !is.na(xGA_5v5)
    )
  ),
  by = game_id
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2b. Load only columns needed for 5v5 vs PK comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------

strength_data <- fread(
  "nhl_2025_26_player_shift_data.csv",
  select = c(
    "game_id",
    "team",
    "period",
    "interval_start",
    "is_5v5",
    "strength",
    "xGA"
  )
)


# Restrict to games retained in the main analysis
valid_game_ids <- unique(
  team_5v5$game_id
)

strength_data <- strength_data[
  game_id %in% valid_game_ids
]


# One team x 5-second interval = one row
strength_team <- strength_data[
  is_5v5 == 1L |
    strength == "PK",
  .(
    state = fifelse(
      first(is_5v5) == 1L,
      "5v5",
      "Penalty Kill"
    ),

    xGA = first(xGA)
  ),
  by = .(
    game_id,
    team,
    period,
    interval_start
  )
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2c. Collapse 5v5 / PK comparison to GAME LEVEL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

game_strength_stats <- strength_team[
  ,
  .(
    five_xga_sum = sum(
      xGA[state == "5v5"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    five_xga_n = sum(
      state == "5v5" &
        !is.na(xGA)
    ),

    pk_xga_sum = sum(
      xGA[state == "Penalty Kill"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    pk_xga_n = sum(
      state == "Penalty Kill" &
        !is.na(xGA)
    )
  ),
  by = game_id
]


# Merge the two game-level tables
boot_game_stats <- merge(
  game_5v5_stats,
  game_strength_stats,
  by = "game_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)


# Missing PK values mean that game contributed no PK intervals
boot_game_stats[
  is.na(pk_xga_sum),
  pk_xga_sum := 0
]

boot_game_stats[
  is.na(pk_xga_n),
  pk_xga_n := 0
]


# ============================================================
# 3. POINT ESTIMATES FROM FULL DATA
# ============================================================

short_xgf <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$short_xgf_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$short_xgf_n)

long_xgf <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$long_xgf_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$long_xgf_n)

short_xga <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$short_xga_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$short_xga_n)

long_xga <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$long_xga_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$long_xga_n)


xgf_drop_pct <-
  100 *
  (short_xgf - long_xgf) /
  short_xgf

xga_increase_pct <-
  100 *
  (long_xga - short_xga) /
  short_xga


five_xga <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$five_xga_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$five_xga_n)

pk_xga <-
  sum(boot_game_stats$pk_xga_sum) /
  sum(boot_game_stats$pk_xga_n)

pk_xga_increase_pct <-
  100 *
  (pk_xga - five_xga) /
  five_xga


relative_size_pct <-
  100 *
  xga_increase_pct /
  pk_xga_increase_pct


cat(
  "\nxGF decrease:",
  round(xgf_drop_pct, 2),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "xGA increase:",
  round(xga_increase_pct, 2),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "PK xGA increase:",
  round(pk_xga_increase_pct, 2),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "Long-shift increase as % of PK increase:",
  round(relative_size_pct, 2),
  "%\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. GAME-CLUSTER BOOTSTRAP
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

B <- 1000L
n_games <- nrow(boot_game_stats)

boot_results <- vector(
  "list",
  B
)


for (b in seq_len(B)) {

  # Sample entire games with replacement
  idx <- sample.int(
    n_games,
    n_games,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  z <- boot_game_stats[idx]


  # ----------------------------------------
  # Short vs long 5v5 means
  # ----------------------------------------

  b_short_xgf <-
    sum(z$short_xgf_sum) /
    sum(z$short_xgf_n)

  b_long_xgf <-
    sum(z$long_xgf_sum) /
    sum(z$long_xgf_n)

  b_short_xga <-
    sum(z$short_xga_sum) /
    sum(z$short_xga_n)

  b_long_xga <-
    sum(z$long_xga_sum) /
    sum(z$long_xga_n)


  b_xgf_drop_pct <-
    100 *
    (b_short_xgf - b_long_xgf) /
    b_short_xgf

  b_xga_increase_pct <-
    100 *
    (b_long_xga - b_short_xga) /
    b_short_xga


  # ----------------------------------------
  # 5v5 vs PK
  # ----------------------------------------

  b_five_xga <-
    sum(z$five_xga_sum) /
    sum(z$five_xga_n)

  b_pk_xga <-
    sum(z$pk_xga_sum) /
    sum(z$pk_xga_n)


  b_pk_increase_pct <-
    100 *
    (b_pk_xga - b_five_xga) /
    b_five_xga


  # ----------------------------------------
  # Relative size
  # ----------------------------------------

  b_relative_size_pct <-
    100 *
    b_xga_increase_pct /
    b_pk_increase_pct


  boot_results[[b]] <- data.table(
    xgf_drop_pct =
      b_xgf_drop_pct,

    xga_increase_pct =
      b_xga_increase_pct,

    pk_xga_increase_pct =
      b_pk_increase_pct,

    relative_size_pct =
      b_relative_size_pct
  )
}


boot_results <- rbindlist(
  boot_results
)


# ============================================================
# 5. BOOTSTRAP 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
# ============================================================

bootstrap_ci <- data.table(
  measure = c(
    "xGF decrease: 0-30 vs 60+",
    "xGA increase: 0-30 vs 60+",
    "PK xGA increase vs 5v5",
    "Long-shift xGA increase relative to PK"
  ),

  estimate = c(
    xgf_drop_pct,
    xga_increase_pct,
    pk_xga_increase_pct,
    relative_size_pct
  ),

  lower_95 = c(
    quantile(
      boot_results$xgf_drop_pct,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$xga_increase_pct,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$pk_xga_increase_pct,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$relative_size_pct,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),

  upper_95 = c(
    quantile(
      boot_results$xgf_drop_pct,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$xga_increase_pct,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$pk_xga_increase_pct,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    quantile(
      boot_results$relative_size_pct,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
)


bootstrap_ci[
  ,
  `:=`(
    estimate = round(
      estimate,
      2
    ),

    lower_95 = round(
      lower_95,
      2
    ),

    upper_95 = round(
      upper_95,
      2
    )
  )
]

bootstrap_ci
```

```{r}
short <- shift_effect[shift_length_group == "0-30"]
long  <- shift_effect[shift_length_group == "60+"]

margin_diff <- margin_results[
  result == "60+ minus 0-30"
]

xgf_ci <- bootstrap_ci[
  measure == "xGF decrease: 0-30 vs 60+"
]

xga_ci <- bootstrap_ci[
  measure == "xGA increase: 0-30 vs 60+"
]

results_table <- data.table(
  Metric = c("xGF", "xGA", "xG margin"),

  `0-30 seconds` = sprintf(
    "%.6f",
    c(short$xGF, short$xGA, short$xG_margin)
  ),

  `60+ seconds` = sprintf(
    "%.6f",
    c(long$xGF, long$xGA, long$xG_margin)
  ),

  Change = c(
    sprintf("-%.1f%%", xgf_ci$estimate),
    sprintf("+%.1f%%", xga_ci$estimate),
    sprintf("%.6f", margin_diff$estimate)
  ),

  `95% CI for change` = c(
    sprintf(
      "-%.1f%% to -%.1f%%",
      xgf_ci$upper_95,
      xgf_ci$lower_95
    ),
    sprintf(
      "+%.1f%% to +%.1f%%",
      xga_ci$lower_95,
      xga_ci$upper_95
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.6f to %.6f",
      margin_diff$lower,
      margin_diff$upper
    )
  )
)

library(gt)

results_gt <- results_table |>
  gt() |>

  # Table title and subtitle
  tab_header(
    title = md("**5v5 Expected Goals by Unit Shift Age**"),
    subtitle = "Comparison of short (0–30 sec) and long (60+ sec) shifts"
  ) |>

  # Bold column headers
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(
      columns = everything()
    )
  ) |>

  # Bold metric names
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = Metric
    )
  ) |>

  # Light blue-gray header
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#E9EFF5"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(
      columns = everything()
    )
  ) |>

  # Subtle alternating rows
  opt_row_striping(
    row_striping = TRUE
  ) |>

  # Align metric names left
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Metric
  ) |>

  # Align numeric results centrally
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -Metric
  ) |>

  # Table font and sizing
  tab_options(
  table.font.names = "Arial",

  # Main table text
  table.font.size = px(17),

  # Title and subtitle
  heading.title.font.size = px(23),
  heading.subtitle.font.size = px(16),

  # Column headers
  column_labels.font.size = px(17),

  # Spacing between rows
  data_row.padding = px(14),

  # Table borders
  table.border.top.color = "#334155",
  table.border.bottom.color = "#334155"
) |>

  # Methodological note
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Values represent average xG per ",
        "five-second team interval. ",
        "Percentage confidence intervals were calculated ",
        "using game-level bootstrapping (1,000 resamples). ",
        "The xG margin difference uses game-clustered ",
        "standard errors."
      )
    )
  )

# Display table
results_gt

# Save as PNG
gt::gtsave(
  results_gt,
  "../images/shift_comparison_table.png",
  vwidth = 1100,
  expand = 15
)

results_gt
```
